questions.questionText: The -ed in “submitted” is pronounced as an extra syllable /ɪd/.

explanations.general: Correto: depois de “t”, o -ed vira sílaba: sub-mit-ted.

content.text: 1 an, 2 The, 3 — (nada), 4 some/— (advice é incontável), 5 an, 6 The.

1 didn't went → didn't go (tempo); 2 my classmate and I has → have (concordância); 3 a extension → an extension (artigo); 4 I have finish… last week → I finished… last week (tempo); 5 I am study → I am studying (tempo); 6 feedbacks → feedback (incontável/artigo); 7 Everyone… are → Everyone… is (concordância); 8 I am agree → I agree (verbo).
